job.description:
Our Leicester cient is looking for 2 Technicians - Tape Testing & Metrology, to join them on a 6 month contract, due to an uplift in work. The roles do have the opportunity to go permanent following the initial timescales needed.

Job Type: Full-time


Department: Manufacturing / Engineering

About the Role


We are looking for a Technician - Tape Testing & Metrology to join our UK team and play a key role in the day-to-day testing, inspection and traceability of HTS tape materials.
This is a hands-on technical role, responsible for operating tape testing and measurement equipment, carrying out incoming inspection of HTS reels, maintaining accurate test and traceability records, and supporting the Tape Insertion Manufacturing Engineer with production activities.
The successful candidate will have a practical, methodical approach, strong attention to detail, and a commitment to quality and accurate data.

Key Responsibilities
Tape Testing & Metrology
· Operate the tape test stand and associated tape-star and thickness measurement equipment on a daily basis.
· Set up and carry out testing and measurement activities in accordance with approved procedures.
· Accurately record, review and maintain test and measurement data.
· Identify and escalate abnormal or out-of-specification results.
· Maintain a clean, organised and controlled testing environment.
Incoming Inspection
· Carry out incoming inspection of all HTS reels received at the UK office before they are released to production.
· Check reel identification, packaging, bag condition and visual condition.
· Perform defined measurements and inspections and accurately record results in the relevant database.
· Maintain full material and reel traceability.
· Identify damaged, non-conforming or suspect material and ensure it is appropriately held or quarantined.
Reel Routing & Material Control
· Make reel routing decisions in line with defined acceptance criteria, including:
o Long-term storage
o Production
o Quarantine / hold
· Maintain accurate records of reel status and location.
· Escalate quality or material issues to the appropriate engineering or quality team.
Equipment & Calibration
· Maintain calibration records for test and measurement equipment.
· Monitor calibration status and ensure equipment remains within its required calibration period.
· Maintain test stand consumables and identify replenishment requirements.
· Carry out routine equipment checks and basic troubleshooting.
· Report equipment faults and support corrective actions as required.
Tape Insertion Support
· Set up and operate the tape insertion line in accordance with approved procedures.
· Support the Tape Insertion Manufacturing Engineer with data logging and production traceability.
· Accurately record process and production information.
· Support engineering trials, investigations and continuous improvement activities.

About You
We are looking for someone who is hands-on, technically minded and highly detail-oriented. You will be comfortable working witequipment and following defined procedures while also being able to recognise when something does not look right.

You will ideally have:
· Previous experience in a measurement technician, manufacturing, inspection, testing or metrology environment.
· Experience using measurement or test equipment.
· Good attention to detail and a methodical approach to work.
· The ability to accurately record and manage technical data.
· An understanding of quality, inspection and traceability requirements.
· Good practical problem-solving skills.
· The ability to follow written procedures and work instructions.
· Good computer skills and confidence working with databases or production records.
· The ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a wider engineering/manufacturing team.

Experience within HTS, superconducting materials, advanced manufacturing, tape processing, metrology or a similar technical environment would be advantageous, but is not essential.

What We Offer
This is an excellent opportunity for a practical and technically capable Technician to develop their experience within a specialist engineering and manufacturing environment.
You will have the opportunity to work closely with engineering and production teams and gain hands-on experience across testing, metrology, material inspection, traceability and tape insertion processes.
If you are organised, quality-focused and enjoy working with technical equipment and data, we would like to hear from you.

job.title: Transport Supervisor
job.description:
Leadership Role | High-Impact Position | Genuine Career Progression
Are you an experienced Transport Supervisor who is ready to take the next step in your career?
Do you have a strong track record of leading transport teams, driving operational standards and delivering excellent customer service - and are you now looking for an opportunity that could develop into a management position?
If you are a motivated, results-driven and commercially aware transport professional with ambition to progress, this could be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.
The position is based in Reading.
The Opportunity
A highly successful and growing international organisation is looking to appoint an experienced Transport Supervisor to play a key role within its transport operation.
This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced Supervisor who is ready to broaden their responsibilities, develop their leadership capability and build towards a future Transport Management position.
This is not simply a supervisory role. You will be actively involved in leading the transport operation, developing people, improving performance and ensuring the highest standards of safety, compliance and customer service.
For the right individual, this role offers a fantastic platform to accelerate your career within a business that invests heavily in its people and leadership talent.
About the Business
Our client is part of a dynamic and financially secure international organisation operating at the forefront of the UK service sector.
Every day the business supports organisations that impact the lives of millions of people across the UK, delivering essential services with a relentless focus on quality and customer experience.
The company also holds Gold EcoVadis status, placing it among the top 5% of over 125,000 companies globally for sustainability and responsible business practices.
People are at the heart of everything they do, and they are committed to building an environment where talented individuals can develop, grow and succeed.
The Role
As Transport Supervisor, you will support the day-to-day leadership of the transport operation, working closely with the management team to ensure it runs safely, efficiently and to the highest operational standards.
Key areas of focus include:
· Leading, motivating and developing a high-performing transport team
· Supervising day-to-day transport operations and driver performance
· Ensuring compliance with transport legislation, Health & Safety requirements and operational standards
· Supporting effective planning, scheduling and resource allocation
· Monitoring fleet and transport performance and identifying opportunities for improvement
· Driving operational efficiency and continuous improvement
· Delivering exceptional levels of customer service
· Supporting the management team with operational and commercial objectives
· Dealing proactively with operational issues and ensuring appropriate corrective action is taken
· Creating a positive, professional and high-accountability team culture
· Supporting the development and implementation of improved processes and ways of working
· Taking increasing responsibility as your experience and capability develops
This is a high-visibility role where your ability to lead from the front, organise effectively and drive results will make a real difference.
Who We Are Looking For
We are looking for an experienced and ambitious Transport Supervisor who is ready to take the next step in their career and develop towards a future management position.
You will bring:
· Proven experience supervising or leading a transport operation
· Strong knowledge of transport operations and driver management
· A genuine passion for operational excellence and customer service
· Strong leadership and people-management skills
· The confidence to make decisions and take ownership of operational issues
· A proactive approach to problem-solving and continuous improvement
· Good commercial awareness and an understanding of operational costs and performance
· Strong communication and organisational skills
· The ambition and desire to progress into a Transport Management role
A CPC Transport Manager qualification would be advantageous, but is not essential for the right candidate. The business is particularly interested in individuals who have the experience, leadership capability and ambition to develop into a management position.
Experience with budgets, fleet performance, compliance or Health & Safety would also be beneficial, along with qualifications such as NEBOSH or IOSH.
Why This Role Stands Out
This is a fantastic opportunity for an experienced Transport Supervisor who feels ready for more responsibility and wants to build a long-term career within a successful international organisation.
You will benefit from:
· Being part of a successful international group
· A people-first culture where leadership is valued
· Genuine career progression into management
· The opportunity to develop your leadership and commercial skills
· The chance to influence, improve and shape the transport operation
· Support and investment in your professional development
· Working within a business committed to sustainability and long-term growth
Ready for the Next Step?
If you are an experienced Transport Supervisor who is ready to take the next step, wants to develop into a management role and is looking for an organisation that will invest in your potential, we would love to hear from you.
This could be the opportunity to turn your supervisory experience into your next management career move.
